test_fresnel_rt: test the fresnel_rt function to compute reflection and transmission coefficients for given refractive indices and incident angle
test_extract_amplitude: test the extract_amplitude function to extract scalar amplitude and direction from an electric field vector
test_FresnelComparisonTest: test the FresnelComparisonTest class to validate FMM scattering matrix results against analytical Fresnel equations
run_fresnel_rt: run the fresnel_rt function with refractive indices n1, n2 and incident angle theta_i to get reflection and transmission
run_extract_amplitude: run the extract_amplitude function on a 3xN electric field array to get complex amplitude and polarization direction
